notes: Simple window on sit.LastEditedWhen: (@LastCutoff, @NewCutoff]. SIT 1 (2020-01-20) is an ISSUE to a customer: InvoiceID+CustomerID set, PO+Supplier NULL, Quantity -10. SIT 2 (2020-02-20) is a RECEIPT from a supplier: PO+Supplier set, Invoice+Customer NULL, Quantity +50. Quantity is CAST to int. ORDER BY StockItemTransactionID.

cases.name: jan-issue
cases.why: Jan window -> SIT 1: the issue shape (Invoice/Customer set, PO/Supplier null, negative qty).

cases.name: feb-receipt
cases.why: Feb window -> SIT 2: the receipt shape (PO/Supplier set, Invoice/Customer null, positive qty).

cases.name: both-months
cases.why: Both transactions ordered by StockItemTransactionID -> both null/set projection combos in one result.

cases.name: upper-boundary-inclusive
cases.why: NewCutoff equals SIT 1's LastEditedWhen -> included (<= bound).
